evidence: The failed chunk0 control called materialize_stage_local_prefill_index_wk inside the large compiled pipeline.
Its optimized HLO therefore accepted raw U8 wk and scales rather than completed FP32 wk parameters.
DB519 previously rejected the same internal raw-FP8 to BF16 to FP32 executable boundary across all 8155 prompt positions.
The present 36.28 mismatches per row and 0.03125 maximum error match DB519's 36.61 mismatches per row and 0.03125-scale BF16-ulp signature.
Mismatch signatures repeat for repeated token IDs even in unrotated lanes, identifying deterministic producer/materialization drift rather than cache-address mapping.
diagnosis.required_correction: Complete raw-FP8 decode and BF16-to-FP32 promotion as separately compiled and synchronized executables for wk0 and wk1; pass only the resulting FP32 arrays into the chunk pipeline; archive and validate all three executable HLO boundaries.
diagnosis.supersedes_for_this_control: RMS/scalar-frontier hypotheses do not explain the already-known wk boundary violation and must not be tested before this control is repaired.

limitations: The failed control gives the legacy-geometry arm no numerical standing.
Statistical and HLO mechanism agreement localize the first correction but do not prove that correction exact.
Only a fresh protected chunk0 run with an exact DB518 layer0 control may adjudicate row0 legacy geometry.
